original_title: The Little Mermaid vs. Mega Jaws
description: In a world where the ocean's deepest secrets come to life, the fabled mermaid faces her greatest nemesis yet: Mega Jaws, nature's deadliest killer. When a terrifying, mutated great white shark emerges from the abyss, it's up to the fearless mermaid to defend her kingdom-both under the sea and on land. With jaw-dropping underwater battles, explosive land chases, and heart-pounding action, this is the guilty pleasure you've been waiting for.
